# cairn admin workflow run-succeeding

Enqueue a synthetic always-succeeding job and run a real scheduler until the row completes. Prints the resulting job_id.

## Help

```text
Enqueue a synthetic always-succeeding job and run a real scheduler until the row completes. Prints
the resulting job_id.

Usage: run-succeeding [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --kind <STRING>
          Workflow kind discriminator (default: test.e2e.always_done)

      --deadline-secs <U64>
          Polling deadline before reporting a timeout (default: 15)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
